children: Overview
Norway airline group's Q3 operating margin reached 21.4% amid strong summer travel demand
Group carried 8.75 mln passengers in Q3, with capacity and load factor rising yr/yr
Punctuality improved for both Norwegian and Widerøe compared to last year
Outlook
Norwegian forecasts winter season production to increase marginally from last year
Company expects full-year 2026 production (ASK) growth of 2% for both Norwegian and Widerøe
Norwegian forecasts underlying unit cost excluding fuel to remain unchanged in 2026 vs 2025
Result Drivers
COST CONTROL - Norwegian Group cited continued focus on cost control as supporting financial results
OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE - Co said strong operational performance during peak summer travel season contributed to results
PUNCTUALITY IMPROVEMENT - Both Norwegian and Widerøe reported improved punctuality, which the company highlighted as a driver of performance
